name: cran_synth_demo_two_predictor_slice
status: public artificial demo; exact conditional on declared decimal export

provenance.transformation: X1 and X2 are unit means over 1984-1989, exported from R and rounded to 9 decimal places; Y values are exported at their documented one-decimal resolution
provenance.scope_note: The official package example also uses X3 and three special outcome predictors. This fixture deliberately omits them to remain inside the proved K=2 class, so it is a two-predictor slice, not a replication of the package estimate.

design.predictor_scaling_note: Positive row scaling changes the V parameterization but not the union of lower solutions over all V, so raw predictor units are valid for this envelope.

arithmetic: decimal strings interpreted as exact rationals
